english.note: Use this when the words come out suddenly and involuntarily, whether or not the speaker is loud.

examples.english: I had no time to think and could only exclaim, “Huh, really?”
examples.traditional: 聽到個消息，我一時緊張，脫口而出：「吓，真㗎？」
